title: Page 7
content_zh:
徐庭却是听得恼怒，一把扯过外衣，也不用夫人帮忙了，呵斥道：“你懂什么！北上的路不太平，大嫂年岁大了，只带徐平夫妻，路上还不知道要吃多少苦。我早一日迎到，大嫂才能早一日安心。”
说罢，他恨不得甩自己几巴掌，眼圈都红了，“都怪我，应该早些请假回乡，迎大嫂来京都奉养。万一大嫂路上有个好歹，我还有什么脸面活下去。我三岁丧父丧母，五岁兄长也去了，大嫂把我当儿子一般养大，含辛茹苦，她不是嫂子，她就是我娘。可我这个当儿子的，当弟弟的，却只顾自己的仕途……”
徐夫人见此，哪里还敢拦阻啊，赶紧帮忙穿衣，道：“老爷不要伤心，嫂子心善明理，定然是做了万全准备才上路。您出城只管往亮灯之处询问，说不定就会碰到嫂子。我另外再让人去我娘家送信，借十几个家丁随您一起出城。”
徐庭对妻子也是情深，若不是心急，方才不会说话这么重。他赶紧道谢，“谢夫人，家里这边还要辛苦你安排一下，嫂子此次来京都，我不准备让她再回老家了。”
“我明白，老爷，正房一直给嫂子留着呢，平日常有打扫，我这就让人再好好拾掇……”
徐夫人话说到一半，突然有二门上的婆子匆忙跑来报信，“老爷，夫人，大门外有人坐了马车，说是老家的大夫人……”
“嫂子！”徐庭夫妻几乎是立刻惊喜喊出声，齐齐奔向门外。
将近十年没见，徐大娘站在大门外，抬头望着徐家的门楣，也是满心的欢喜和骄傲。
当年，她本可以改嫁的，但实在觉得小叔子可怜，就不顾娘家反对，毅然留了下来。苦没少吃，外人的闲话也没少听，说起来都是眼泪。但幸好小叔子争气，一路考了上去，待她也是如同母亲一般孝顺尊重，算是苦尽甘来。
如今，在京都团聚，更是感慨。
这会儿，徐庭夫妻已经是匆忙迎了出来。
一见头发花白的老嫂子，徐庭直接就跪下了，泪珠劈里啪啦往下掉，“嫂子，您怎么不早些送信来，我可以请假回老家去接您啊！万一路上有个好歹，您要我怎么有脸活下去！”
说罢，他也不顾周围看热闹的路人，抱着老嫂子的腿就哭开了。
徐夫人也抹眼泪，但总算比徐庭好一些，她同样跪倒磕头，末了帮着嫂子又扶了自己老爷起来，劝道：“老爷，嫂子已经来了，以后一家团聚，再好不过，咱们有话进屋慢慢说。”
“好，进屋，嫂子快进屋。”徐庭直接弯腰，坚持把徐大娘背在背上，迈过了门槛。
徐嫂子夫妻，还有梁浩海都拿着简单的行李跟在后边，马车自有门房看管处置。
路人看了热闹，议论两句也就散了。
徐大娘被徐庭夫妻送进主院正房，话家常庆团圆，很快徐平夫妻也被请了进去，只留了梁浩海在院子里。
徐家的管家上前招呼，“小兄弟，怎么称呼，先随我去吃口饭吧，都是一家人，不要客套。”
梁浩海却是拱手，笑着应道：“多谢，但你们老爷一会儿许是要找我说话，我还是多等一下。”

徐管家听得纳闷，不明白自家老爷为什么要找一个小厮问话，难道是大夫人在老家有什么事吗？
正这般疑惑着，徐庭当真开门走了出来，他打量梁浩海几眼，眼底的惊讶几乎要满溢出来。
“徐大人，我们还是去您书房说话吧。”梁浩海弯腰点头，模样很是恭顺。
徐庭神色添了几分忐忑，赶紧应道：“好，请跟我走。”
说罢，他亲自引路，两人径直去了前院的书房。
徐管家机灵的一路跟随，然后亲自上了茶水，然后守在门口。
书房里，梁浩海毫不客气的喝下一杯浓茶，熬夜带来的困顿消散很多，这才道：“徐大人，在下冒昧前来，耽搁了您一家团聚，实在是对不住。原本我也是百般考量，才选中徐大娘帮我这个忙，为了谢礼，我也很是头疼。没想到，如今事情有了进展，倒是您要感谢我寻徐大娘帮忙了。”
“梁统领这话怎么说？本官很是糊涂。若是为了童小姐之事，本官一定会帮忙，毕竟你们一路上对我嫂子照顾良多。你可能也听说过，我嫂子如同亲母，只要嫂子开口，我绝无二话，至于谢礼，就不必了。”
徐庭是御史，平日最重要的就是行得正坐得端，即便梁浩海是皇上跟前的红人，他也不愿意轻易有什么牵扯。
梁浩海听他这么说，心里添了几分敬佩，欢喜自己没有找错人。“徐大人还是听我说说，再决定要不要我的谢礼吧。”
徐庭皱眉，轻轻点头。
“徐大人同台州知府吴同是多年好友吧，这些年一直也没断了联系，去年府考之后，台州的中举名单送来京都，吴同是不是请徐大人在那些举子进京后多多照应，徐大人寻了城外一座小庄安顿那些举子？三月前，皇上接到密报，吴同涉嫌科考舞弊，我赶去台州，密报的知情人已经被灭门，只留一个女儿藏了涉案的名单，最后也被灭口，但幸好名单被我拿到了。此案牵连甚大，就是吴同的本家——户部尚书吴大人也牵涉在内，而徐大人您怕是免不得也要被查问一番。”
“什么？”徐庭听得头上冷汗都流了下来，霍然起身，“此事我完全不知，更没有参与，是吴同害我！”
梁浩海示意他坐下，亲手替他倒了茶，笑道：“我当然知道徐大人是清白的，幸好，皇上有些顾虑，此案要压到明年才能揭开，而这段时间，也是你我的机会。”
徐庭心里如惊涛骇浪一般，他是御史，平日没少得罪朝中官员，若是他被牵涉到这样的大案中，不死也要脱层皮，说不准要被罢官，运气差了就是满门发配。
过了良久，他起身行礼道谢，“梁大人这份谢礼太丰厚了，本官受之有愧。”
梁浩海笑着扶了他，“既然徐大人这般说，那我也就不客气了。不如明日请徐大娘认下童小姐做义女，对外就说一路上两人很投缘，以后您就是童小姐的叔叔，童小姐在京都也多门亲戚走动，而我以后娶童小姐为妻，也要叫您一声叔叔。”
徐庭抬头，直直望向梁浩海，见他眼底满是认真，并没有玩笑之色。
他忍不住多嘴问了一句，“梁统领，以你的身分，世家贵女，甚至是娶公主为妻都容易，为何偏偏要费尽心机，只为了一个五品郎中之女……”
梁浩海没有回答，反问：“我也好奇，徐大人娶发妻十年，即便只得一女，依旧没有纳妾收通房？”

徐庭眼底闪过一抹了然和尴尬，拱手道歉，“是本官失礼了，弱水三千，只取一瓢饮。情之一字，没有任何道理可言。”
“大人通透，本就如此。人生一世，草木一秋，荣华富贵都是过眼云烟，重要的是身边那个陪你看风景的人。”
“梁统领年纪还轻就有如此感悟，实在难得。”
两人这般说着，居然有几分知交的感觉。
没过片刻，茶水喝完，定了之后诸事，梁浩海就告辞了。
徐夫人安顿了嫂子，不见老爷回来，索性就寻来书房，见自家老爷坐在书房里发呆，担忧的上前询问。
不想，徐庭开口道：“马上去把莲姐儿的偏院拾掇一间好房出来，有位姑娘要来家里小住。”
content_en:
Xu Ting was angry when he heard this. He grabbed his coat and scolded her without using his wife's help: "What do you know! The road going north is not smooth. My sister-in-law is old. She only takes Xu Ping and his wife with her. I don't know how much hardship they will have to endure on the road. The sooner I welcome you, the sooner my sister-in-law can feel at ease."
After saying that, he wanted to slap himself a few times, his eyes were red, "It's all my fault. I should have taken leave earlier and returned to my hometown to welcome my sister-in-law to come to Kyoto to support me. If something happened to my sister-in-law on the road, how could I have the face to live. I lost my father and my mother when I was three years old, and my brother also passed away when I was five years old. My sister-in-law raised me like a son, and it was hard work. She is not my sister-in-law, she is my mother. But as a son or a younger brother, I only care about my own career..."
Seeing this, Mrs. Xu didn't dare to stop her. She quickly helped to get dressed and said: "Master, don't be sad. My sister-in-law is kind-hearted and sensible. She must have made all preparations before setting off on the road. When you go out of the city, just ask where the lights are. Maybe you will meet my sister-in-law. I will also send someone to my mother's house to deliver the letter, and I will borrow a dozen servants to accompany you out of the city."
Xu Ting also has deep affection for his wife. If he wasn't impatient, he wouldn't have spoken so harshly. He quickly thanked her, "Mrs. Xie, I have to work hard for you to make arrangements at home. My sister-in-law is coming to Kyoto this time, and I am not going to let her go back to her hometown again."
"I understand, Master, the main room has been reserved for my sister-in-law. I have to clean it every day, so I will have it tidied up..."
In the middle of Mrs. Xu's words, suddenly a woman from the second door came to report in a hurry, "Master, madam, there is someone riding a carriage outside the gate, saying it is the eldest lady from my hometown..."
"Sister-in-law!" Xu Ting and his wife almost immediately shouted in surprise and rushed out the door.
After not seeing each other for nearly ten years, Aunt Xu stood outside the gate, looking up at the lintel of the Xu family, and she was also filled with joy and pride.
At that time, she could have remarried, but she really felt that her brother-in-law was pitiful, so she decided to stay regardless of her parents' objections. I endured endless hardships and listened to outsiders' gossip. Every time I talked about it, I shed tears. But fortunately, my brother-in-law worked hard and passed the exam all the way. He treated her with filial respect and respect like a mother. It was a blessing after all the hardships.
Now, being reunited in Kyoto is even more emotional.
At this moment, Xu Ting and his wife came out in a hurry.
As soon as he saw the gray-haired old sister-in-law, Xu Ting knelt down and burst into tears, "Sister-in-law, why didn't you send a letter earlier? I can ask for leave and go back to my hometown to pick you up! What if something happens along the way? How can you expect me to live with the dignity!"
After that, he ignored the onlookers around him, hugged his old sister-in-law's legs and started crying.
Mrs. Xu also wiped away tears, but she was better than Xu Ting. She also knelt down and kowtowed. Finally, she helped her sister-in-law and helped her husband up, and persuaded: "Master, my sister-in-law is already here. It will be best for the family to reunite in the future. If we have anything to say, we can go inside and talk slowly."
"Okay, come in, sister-in-law, come in quickly." Xu Ting bent down directly, insisted on carrying Aunt Xu on his back, and crossed the threshold.
Sister-in-law Xu and his wife, as well as Liang Haohai, followed behind with simple luggage, and the carriage was guarded by a concierge.
Passers-by saw the excitement and left their comments.
Aunt Xu was sent to the main room of the main courtyard by Xu Ting and his wife, and the family celebrated their reunion. Soon Xu Ping and his wife were also invited in, leaving only Liang Haohai in the courtyard.
The butler of the Xu family came forward and greeted, "Little brother, what do you call me? Come and have a meal with me first. We are all a family, so don't be polite."
Liang Haohai held up his hands and responded with a smile: "Thank you very much, but your master may want to talk to me later, so I'd better wait a little longer."
Butler Xu was puzzled when he heard this. He didn't understand why his master wanted to ask a boy to question him. Could it be that the eldest lady had something to do at home?
Just like this, Xu Ting opened the door and walked out. He looked at Liang Haohai for a few times, and the surprise in his eyes almost overflowed.
"Master Xu, we'd better go to your studySpeak. "Liang Haohai bent down and nodded, looking very respectful.
Xu Ting's expression became a little more uneasy, and he quickly responded: "Okay, please come with me. "
After that, he personally led the way, and the two of them went straight to the study in the front yard.
Butler Xu cleverly followed him all the way, served tea himself, and then stood guard at the door.
In the study, Liang Haohai drank a cup of strong tea unceremoniously. The hardship caused by staying up late dissipated a lot, and then he said: "Master Xu, I have taken the liberty to come here and delayed your family reunion. I am really sorry. Originally, I considered everything before choosing Aunt Xu to do this for me. I also had a headache because of the thank you gift. Unexpectedly, now that things have progressed, you would like to thank me for asking Aunt Xu for help. "
"What did Commander Liang say? I am very confused. If it is for Miss Tong, I will definitely help. After all, you have taken good care of my sister-in-law along the way. You may have also heard that my sister-in-law is like a biological mother. As long as my sister-in-law asks, I will say nothing. As for thanking you, there is no need for it. "
Xu Ting is the imperial censor, and the most important thing is to act and sit upright. Even though Liang Haohai is a popular person in front of the emperor, he is not willing to get involved easily.
When Liang Haohai heard what he said, he felt a little more admiration in his heart, and was happy that he had not found the wrong person. "Master Xu, you should listen to me and decide whether you want my thank you gift or not. "
Xu Ting frowned and nodded slightly.
"Master Xu and Wu Tong, the prefect of Taizhou, have been friends for many years. They have kept in touch with each other over the years. After the prefectural examination last year, the list of successful candidates in Taizhou was sent to Kyoto. Did Wu Tong ask Master Xu to take care of those candidates after they came to Beijing? Master Xu found a small village outside the city to settle those candidates? Three months ago, the emperor received a secret report that Wu Tong was suspected of cheating in scientific examinations. I rushed to Taizhou. The insider of the report had been exterminated. Only one daughter was left to hide the list of people involved in the case. In the end, she was also silenced. Fortunately, I got the list. This case is very involved, even Wu Tong's family, Mr. Wu, the Minister of Household Affairs, is also involved. Mr. Xu, I am afraid that you will inevitably be questioned. "
"What? "Xu Ting heard the cold sweat on his head and stood up suddenly, "I don't know anything about this matter, let alone participated in it. It was Wu Tong who harmed me! "
Liang Haohai motioned him to sit down, poured tea for him with his own hands, and said with a smile: "Of course I know Mr. Xu is innocent. Fortunately, the emperor has some concerns. The case will not be revealed until next year, and this period is also an opportunity for you and me. "
Xu Ting's heart felt like a turbulent sea. He was a royal censor, and he often offended officials in the court. If he was involved in such a major case, he would be stripped of his skin even if he died, and he might be dismissed from office. If he was unlucky, he would be sent to all the families.
After a long time, he stood up and bowed to express his thanks, "Master Liang, this gift of thanks is so generous, and I feel ashamed to receive it. "
Liang Haohai smiled and helped him, "Since Mr. Xu said this, I won't be polite. Why don't you ask Aunt Xu to recognize Miss Tong as your adopted daughter tomorrow, and tell the public that the two of you have hit it off along the way, and that you will be Miss Tong's uncle from now on. Miss Tong also has many relatives in Kyoto, and when I marry Miss Tong in the future, I will also call you uncle. "
Xu Ting raised his head and looked straight at Liang Haohai, seeing that his eyes were full of seriousness and no joke at all.
He couldn't help but ask more, "Commander Liang, with your status, it is easy for you to be a noble daughter of an aristocratic family, or even marry a princess. Why do you have to go to such great lengths just to get the daughter of a fifth-grade doctor..."
Liang Haohai did not answer, but asked: "I am also curious, Mr. Xu has been married for ten years, and even if he only has one daughter, he still does not take in concubines or take over the house? "
A flash of understanding and embarrassment flashed in Xu Ting's eyes, and he apologized, "I'm rude, I only drink one gourd of water. There is no reason for the word love. "
“My lord is transparent, that’s how it is. Life is a lifetime, grass and trees are autumn, glory and wealth are fleeting, the important thing is the people around youA person to accompany you to see the scenery. "
“It’s really rare for Commander Liang to have such an understanding at such a young age. "
The two of them were talking like this, and they actually felt like they were close friends.
After a while, after the tea was finished and everything was settled, Liang Haohai left.
Mrs. Xu settled her sister-in-law, but when she didn't see her master come back, she simply went to the study. When she saw her master sitting in the study in a daze, she came forward to ask worriedly.
Not wanting to, Xu Ting said: "Immediately go and pack up a good room in Sister Lian's side yard. A girl is coming to stay at home. "
